from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json

root=Path.cwd()
cfg=json.loads((root/"knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json").read_text())
mapping={
 "candidate_dispatch.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/candidate_dispatch.py",
 "candidate_policy_sha256":"control/hourly/candidate_queue.py",
 "evidence_wake.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/evidence_wake.py",
 "build_wake.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/build_wake.py",
 "model_quality_gate.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/model_quality_gate.py",
 "astra_review_wake.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/astra_review_wake.py",
 "measurement_wake.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/measurement_wake.py",
 "supervisor_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/supervisor.py",
 "astra_autonomous_review.py_sha256":"control/codex_supervisor/astra_autonomous_review.py",
}
bad=[]
for key,rel in mapping.items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if cfg.get(key)!=actual:
        bad.append({"key":key,"path":rel})
print("PIN_VERIFY="+json.dumps({"checked":len(mapping),"mismatch":bad},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
if bad:
    raise SystemExit(41)
